# Programs Four summer 2027 tracks live (data analytics, internal audit, investment accounting, public affairs) plus three spring 2027 interns; actuarial has come down; last year also underwriting, digital marketing, visual design and IT


*Last updated: November 2026*


Symetra's summer 2027 internships are open right now. As of October 28, 2026 the[Symetra job board](https://symetra.eightfold.ai/careers) lists four remote summer 2027 internships, **Data Analytics, Internal Audit, Investment Accounting & Reporting and Public Affairs** , plus three spring 2027 interns. The **2027 Actuarial Internship Program** that opened September 2 is no longer listed. In plain words: you apply during 2026, you intern in summer 2027.


Symetra, the Bellevue, Washington life insurer and retirement company, runs a 12-week summer program that's mostly remote: it ships interns their equipment. Last year its investment, underwriting, marketing, design and public affairs internships went up between mid-September and mid-October 2025, and an IT internship followed in late January 2026. This year the data analytics, internal audit, investment accounting and public affairs tracks are already up, so apply now; underwriting, marketing and design haven't appeared yet.


---


## What Is a Symetra Internship?


A Symetra internship is a paid, 12-week summer program at Symetra Financial Corporation, a life insurance, retirement and employee benefits company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, whose life insurer was founded in 1957. Symetra is a wholly owned subsidiary of Japan's Sumitomo Life, according to its[about page](https://www.symetra.com/about-us/about-symetra/) . Its 2026 internship postings described about 2.3 million customers and over 2,600 employees. Interns work with actuaries, investment teams, underwriters, marketers and engineers, and join sessions with senior leaders. It isn't connected to Symmetry Financial Group, an unrelated agency that recruits commission-based insurance agents.


## When Do Symetra Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Symetra posts its internships track by track, not all at once. The actuarial internship comes first: the 2027 posting was created September 2, 2026, a week earlier than the 2026 one (September 9, 2025), about eight and a half months before a mid-May start. The other tracks followed last year between September 17 and October 15, 2025, about three to four weeks earlier than the cycle before, and this year internal audit, public affairs, data analytics and investment accounting internships were up by October 28, 2026, while the actuarial posting had come down. Underwriting, marketing and design haven't posted yet, so check the board weekly. The one IT internship we found for 2026 was created January 27, 2026, so IT for summer 2027 is expected around late January 2027.


Now · late October 2026 YOU ARE HERE

Actuarial students: apply first. Everyone else, use the wait: the[Breaking Games SQL Database Architecture Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships/breaking-games-sql-database-architecture-nov-2026) or the[Yinan Zhao Investing & Financial Modeling Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships/yinan-zhao-investing-financial-modeling-nov-2026) gives you a finished, remote project to point to when Symetra's other tracks open.

*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Symetra posts no deadline and doesn't say "until filled," so this is a rolling window, and that cuts both ways. The actuarial posting is a single program with several actuarial teams behind it, and the earlier you apply, the more of those seats are still open. One job board showed an "apply by" date of January 6, 2026 for last year's actuarial internship, but that came from the board, not from Symetra, so don't count on it. For the other tracks, the risk is missing the posting altogether: last year they appeared over about four weeks in September and October. This year four of them were up by October 28, 2026, so apply now, and join Symetra's talent network to catch underwriting, marketing and design if they post.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


The live actuarial posting and last year's postings set these requirements:


• **Degree:** a bachelor's degree in progress or completed, with "a strong quantitative background including college level mathematics" for actuarial; the program is open to current students and recent graduates.


• **Exams:** not required. Symetra's internship page says it doesn't require an actuarial exam pass.


• **Work authorization:** "Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role," per the actuarial posting.


• **Internet:** at least 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload over fiber, cable or DSL; satellite (such as Starlink) and cellular hotspots don't qualify, and you test your speed when you apply.


• **Track extras (2026):** public affairs wanted rising juniors or seniors, and visual design applicants had to pass a basic design test.


### Do You Need an Actuarial Exam for Symetra's Internship?


No. Symetra says it doesn't require an exam pass, and the 2027 posting lists only beginner to intermediate Excel, strong analytical and communication skills, and SQL, R or Python as preferred. It does help with exams once you're in: Symetra reimburses one ACTEX or ASM study manual and one exam registration fee. No posting names a GPA minimum.

## What Skills Does Symetra Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


Across the 2027 actuarial posting and nine 2026 intern postings, the common ground is **communication** (9 of 10), **analytical and problem-solving skills** and **a self-starting, curious attitude** (8 each), plus **Excel or Microsoft Office** (7). The tracks then split: **actuarial** prefers SQL, R or Python modeling; **investments** add Bloomberg, reconciliations and credit analysis; **marketing and design** ask for Adobe tools and digital marketing interest; **IT security** asks for SIEM tools and frameworks such as NIST.

## What Is the Symetra Application and Interview Process Like?


Symetra doesn't publish its full interview rounds, but the actuarial posting spells out the steps it requires:


1. **Apply on Eightfold.** Each track is a separate posting on the Symetra job board.


2. **Internet check.** You test your connection during the application and confirm it meets 100 Mbps down and 20 Mbps up on fiber, cable or DSL.


3. **Phone screen.** The first conversation is a phone screen.


4. **Video interviews with identity checks.** After the phone screen, you must be on video for every interview, and Symetra verifies candidates' identity at key points.


5. **Track tests.** Some tracks add a test; last year's visual design applicants needed "a proficient score on basic design test."


Our[behavioral interview guide](https://www.extern.com/post/behavioral-interview-questions-star-method-guide) shows how to prepare stories for the video rounds.

## How Do You Stand Out for a Symetra Internship?


Three moves. **First, apply on the right clock.** The data analytics, internal audit, investment accounting and public affairs internships are live now, so apply this week; the actuarial posting has already come down. **Second, show you can work remotely.** The program is mostly remote, so give one example of a project you finished on your own schedule, with clear written updates along the way. **Third, bring a technical edge without an exam.** No exam is required, so SQL, R or Python work you can explain stands out on the actuarial posting. Symetra says its interns "often become lasting members of our team," but it publishes no applicant count or conversion rate.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Symetra internship?


No. Symetra's summer 2026 interns started in May 2026. The open door now is summer 2027: as of October 28, 2026, Symetra lists four remote summer 2027 internships (Data Analytics, Internal Audit, Investment Accounting & Reporting and Public Affairs). The 2027 Actuarial Internship Program, posted September 2, is no longer listed.


### When do Symetra internships for summer 2027 open?


They are open now. The actuarial internship opened September 2, 2026 and was no longer listed by October 28; data analytics, internal audit, investment accounting and public affairs internships for summer 2027 are live, matching last year, when the other tracks went up between September 17 and October 15, 2025. IT internships are expected around late January 2027, based on one 2026 posting.


### Is the Symetra internship remote?


Mostly, yes. The 2027 actuarial internship is 100% remote with the option to use a Symetra office if you live nearby, and Symetra ships interns their equipment. Not every track was remote last year: the 2026 Investment Risk internship was hybrid in Farmington, Connecticut.


### How much do Symetra interns make?


The 2027 actuarial internship pays $27 to $30 an hour, up from $22 to $25 for 2026. Last year's other internships, including commercial mortgage loans, high yield, visual design and IT security, also listed $22 to $25. Don't assume the 2027 rise applies to other tracks until they post.


### Do I need an actuarial exam for Symetra's internship?


No. Symetra says it doesn't require an exam pass. The 2027 posting asks for a bachelor's degree in progress with strong college-level math, Excel skills and, preferably, SQL, R or Python. Symetra reimburses one study manual and one exam registration fee during the internship.


### Does Symetra sponsor visas for interns?


Not for the actuarial internship. Its posting says Symetra doesn't provide work visa sponsorship or support, and applicants must be authorized to work in the US at hire. Check each track's posting when it appears, but plan on needing your own US work authorization.


### What is the Symetra interview process?


Symetra starts with a phone screen, then requires video for every later interview and verifies candidates' identity. You also test your home internet speed when applying. Some tracks add a test: last year's visual design applicants had to pass a basic design test. Symetra doesn't publish the number of rounds.


### Is Symetra the same as Symmetry Financial Group?


No. Symetra is a Bellevue, Washington life insurance, retirement and benefits company owned by Japan's Sumitomo Life. Symmetry Financial Group is an unrelated organization that recruits commission-based insurance agents. Symetra's internships are paid hourly and posted on its own job board.
